resolution.reason: Static code establishes the consumer math and source-side producers, but the final MiiIcon GameUber stage/binder, live area records, default registry view, selected environment resource, CPU-to-GPU pack/upload, and frame resources are not captured.
capture_boundary: Immediately before every relevant MiiIcon GameUber draw, capture the complete 9024-byte cbuf9 allocation.
At the same draw, capture fragment location 27's gsys_user4 texture view and sampler, including format, dimensions, mip/layer selection, and texels.

Record the draw's program, viewport/varyings, render-context stage history, selected environment resource key, active AreaEnvironmentRecord IDs, and whether global stage 9 and its cleanup ran in that context.
Only after the actually sampled selector set is known may the full cbuf9 capture be reduced to fixed words and the selected 0x200-byte records.
forbidden_substitutions: mii_icon environment-set selection inferred from the MiiIcon snapshot name

functions.evidence: Allocates 0xab0 bytes, initializes the singleton, and stores DAT_71040e9ff8.
Initializes the manager and copies the default GPU registry view at owner+0x58 into manager+0x718.
Updates selector-manager frame state and active area records before the global environment frame-source update.
Creates the literal EnvId target when area records exist, draws each record ID as float(id)/255, and installs manager+0x718 at render-context+0x100.
Restores render-context+0x100 and resets a runtime selector view to the default registry owner+0x58 view.
Uses the record's first uint as a 0x200 stride index and copies an exact 0x200-byte source span into the CPU environment source with conditional manager overrides.
Allocates the 0x2258-byte CPU-side environment singleton and calls its initializer.
Initializes the CPU-side object, including sixteen 0x200-byte record spans; these constructor values are not substituted for active MiiIcon state.
Resolves the selected environment resource state, writes frame values beginning at object+0xf8, and overlays active area records.
Resolves the selected/default environment resource key through the runtime resource table and returns its parameter payload at resource data+0xe8.
Calls the area-environment update and then the global environment frame-source update before global rendering stages.
At stage value 9, calls the area environment ID selector renderer when the singleton exists.
The checked binary contains the direct selector-binding restore call at 0x7101bc02f8.
Creates MiiStamp state and passes the exact MiiIcon name to the generic snapshot setting loader.
Loads gfx__SnapshotSetting and dispatches camera, lighting/environment, post-process, and render-flag application.
Existing schema-4 snapshot ledger establishes this separate snapshot lighting/environment path; it is not the 9024-byte GameUber Env block.

GOT slot resolves exactly to DAT_71040104c0.

data_types.evidence: Exact allocation size 0xab0; record count/pointer at +0x58/+0x60, runtime target/view at +0x710/+0x718.
First uint is used by both the selector draw and CPU record overlay; source payload begins at record+0x110.
Exact CPU allocation size 0x2258; environment update base is object+0xf8. No identity with the 0x2340 GPU upload image is asserted.
Two-word key/index pair used to resolve a runtime environment resource.
Exact fragment cbuf9 declaration size 0x2340 with selector-indexed 0x200-byte records.
